android.desc:
Looking for a powerful, fast, and secure way to manage your documents? DocuFix is the ultimate all-in-one PDF editor and toolkit that lets you handle every document task completely offline. No internet connection required, no cloud uploads, and absolutely zero privacy risks!

Whether you need to merge multiple files, sign a contract, compress a heavy document, or convert images to PDF, DocuFix has you covered with professional-grade tools right in your pocket.

🔥 WHY CHOOSE DOCUFIX?

• 100% Offline Processing: Your files never leave your device. Complete privacy and security.
• All Tools Unlocked: Access professional-grade PDF editing features without restrictions.
• Lightning Fast: Powered by an optimized local engine for instant document rendering and editing.
• No Intrusive Permissions: We don't ask for internet or broad storage access. You are in control.

🛠️ COMPLETE PDF TOOLKIT & FEATURES:

Edit & Annotate
• Edit Actual PDF Text: Don't just draw over files! Our advanced editor lets you tap on existing text in the document to modify words, fix typos, and change sentences just like a desktop word processor.
• Sign PDFs: Add your personal signature to contracts, forms, and documents instantly.
• Watermark: Protect your intellectual property by adding custom text watermarks to your pages.
• Page Numbers: Easily insert headers, footers, and page numbers to keep large documents organized.

Merge, Split & Organize
• Merge PDFs: Combine multiple documents into a single, seamless PDF file.
• Split PDFs: Break large documents down into smaller files or separate chapters.
• Reorder & Organize: Drag and drop to rearrange pages exactly how you want them.
• Extract & Delete Pages: Pull out the specific pages you need, or delete blank/unwanted pages.
• Crop Pages: Adjust margins and crop out unnecessary whitespace for cleaner reading.

Convert & Compress
• Image to PDF: Convert JPG, PNG, and JPEG images into a professional PDF document. Perfect for scanning receipts or homework!
• PDF to Images: Extract high-quality images from any document to save in your gallery.
• Compress PDF: Shrink huge file sizes for easy email sharing without losing readable quality.
• Grayscale: Convert colored documents into black-and-white to save on printing ink.
• Flatten PDFs: Lock in signatures, forms, and annotations so they cannot be altered.
